dimensions.assessment: Affects private fund investment advisers holding assets between the prior and new thresholds, as well as the SEC.

dimensions.assessment: Changes the asset threshold by $25 million and institutes periodic inflation indexing.

Amends the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 to alter SEC registration exemption rules and mandate regulatory adjustments.
dimensions.evidence: Section 203(m) of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 (15 U.S.C. 80b-3(m)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change with recurring adjustments every 5 years.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall, every 5 years, adjust the dollar amount described under paragraph (1)

importance_detail.rationale: Modifies the registration exemption threshold for certain private fund investment advisers from $150 million to $175 million and mandates inflation adjustments every 5 years.
